author: AlirezaAlampour
description: V3: V2 stack (7-layer UNet, MLP×4, Muon+EMA, Int8 QAT, 4h DGX Spark) + eval-only 5-order backoff n-gram cache mixed at α=0.2 with the model head. No change to the shipped artifact vs V2; the n-gram table is built online from scored validation tokens (legal score-first pattern, no peeking). 3-seed mean improves by 0.02894 BPB over V2 (1.39693 → 1.36799).
